# forward KL  = (1/n) sum L_i ln L_i = 10   -> sum L_i ln L_i = 10 n
# backward KL = -(1/n) sum ln L_i       = 10 -> sum ln L_i     = -10 n
# Work in log-space: u=ln A, v=ln B, w=ln C.

def eqs(x):
    u, v, w = x
    A = np.exp(u); B = np.exp(v); C = np.exp(w)
    f1 = (m1*A + m2*B + m3*C - n) / n
    f2 = (m1*A*u + m2*B*v + m3*C*w - 10*n) / (10*n)
    f3 = (m1*u + m2*v + m3*w + 10*n) / (10*n)
    return [f1, f2, f3]
